newsitem.title: USA: Petroleum Geo-Services Q1 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Petroleum Geo-Services Q1 net rises.

text.p: Petroleum Geo-Services on Wednesday reported first quarter net operating income of $6.9 million, or $0.21 per share, compared to $2.8 million, or $0.10, for the same period the year before.
Petroleum Geo-Services said its first-quarter 1997 revenues were $94.3 million, compared to $87.9 million a year ago.
The operating net-income results exclude an extraordinary charge of $3.4 million, or $0.11 per share, from the early retirement of senior notes, the company said.
Petroleum Geo-Services had 32.5 million shares outstanding in the first quarter of 1997, and 26.8 million shares outstanding in the first quarter of 1996.
